settings.title: Quote review
settings.description: A simple starting point for travellers who want to explore their options before committing to deeper planning support.
settings.includes: Best for straightforward bookings, general guidance, and the first conversation about where you want to go.

settings.title: Planning consult
settings.description: A paid strategy session for clients who want focused destination advice, clear next steps, and expert input before booking.
settings.includes: Use this card to outline consult duration, follow-up notes, and exactly what planning support is covered in the fee.

settings.title: Bespoke itinerary design
settings.description: For clients who need a more hands-on planning service, layered recommendations, or a tailored itinerary build.
settings.includes: Perfect for complex trips, concierge-style planning, and premium add-on work that sits beyond the standard booking scope.

settings.title: Initial trip conversation
settings.description: Use this area to explain the discovery call, destination chat, or early-stage guidance that is already part of your process.

settings.title: Standard booking support
settings.description: Clarify the services included once a client books with you, such as supplier coordination, reminders, or general trip administration.

settings.title: Access to the logged-in hub
settings.description: Show that booked clients move into a private dashboard for itineraries, forms, tickets, and payment-related information.

settings.title: Consultation sessions
settings.description: Use this card for paid phone or video consults where clients are paying for dedicated planning time and specialist advice.

settings.title: Detailed itinerary design
settings.description: Spell out the itinerary work that falls outside your included booking service, especially when research or curation is more complex.

settings.title: Additional planning requests
settings.description: Reserve this for add-on work like extra revisions, layered destination research, or concierge-style extras that need separate pricing.

settings.title: Upcoming Trip
settings.description: Use this card for a future trip summary, itinerary snapshot, or quick travel overview.

settings.title: My Tickets
settings.description: Reserve this area for ticket confirmations, delivery notes, or park access details once connected.

settings.title: Forms
settings.description: Use this card later for pre-travel forms, client questionnaires, waivers, or onboarding steps.

settings.title: Payments
settings.description: Future payment schedules, deposits, reminders, and invoice links can sit here without changing the dashboard layout.

settings.title: Secret Shop
settings.description: Link clients into an exclusive members-only shopping experience, rewards area, or curated offers page.

settings.title: Guides / Planning Tools
settings.description: Point customers to planning guides, prep resources, destination tips, and future travel tools from here.

settings.title: Complete pre-travel form
settings.description: Placeholder task for intake forms, preferences, dietary details, or special requests.

settings.title: Review itinerary
settings.description: Use this to guide clients toward their itinerary page, trip summary, or planning notes later.

settings.title: Check tickets
settings.description: Reserve this action for important ticket checks, delivery confirmations, or access instructions.

settings.title: Book planning call
settings.description: Use this next-step slot for consultation bookings, support callbacks, or itinerary review sessions.

settings.title: Disney Cruise getaway
settings.description: Example placeholder for a previous trip, recap, or archived planning record.

settings.title: Theme park family escape
settings.description: Another placeholder card showing how past journeys can be surfaced inside the portal later.

settings.heading: Client Hub
settings.intro: Your private dashboard is designed for logged-in customers only. Phase 1 keeps the structure inside the theme so you can launch the client experience now and connect real trip systems later.
settings.member_note: Keep this page as the front-end shell for future Salesforce, Travefy, Magical Tickets, VTO, Typeform, metafield, or metaobject integrations.
settings.travefy_intro: This itinerary is loaded automatically from the Travefy itinerary ID saved on the logged-in customer record.
settings.travefy_empty_message: No Travefy itinerary has been linked to this customer yet.
settings.next_steps_intro: These are placeholder actions for the first release. Replace them later with customer-specific tasks, forms, or booking milestones.
settings.past_trips_intro: Use this area to show archived holidays, previous journeys, or repeat-travel inspiration.
settings.demo_trip_title: Your next luxury escape is taking shape
settings.demo_trip_summary: This optional hero card gives you a polished populated state for demos before live trip data exists.
settings.empty_state_heading: We can't see an active trip on your account yet
settings.empty_state_body: Your client hub is ready, but no live trip has been connected to this account yet. Start planning, browse Magical Tickets, or dive into guides while the integrations are still future-phase work.
settings.cta_body: Keep one clear growth action at the bottom of the hub so customers can move from account management back into planning.
settings.guest_heading: Choose the planning support that fits your trip
settings.guest_intro: This side of the client hub is for new and prospective clients. It sets out how consultations work, what support is included, and which planning services are available as paid add-ons before the private portal experience begins.
settings.guest_badge_copy: Start with transparent pricing and service scope now, then connect travellers into the logged-in hub once they book.
settings.guest_pricing_intro: Position these cards as the clearest way for a client to understand how they can work with you and what level of support they are choosing.
settings.guest_services_intro: Use this section to remove ambiguity. Clients should be able to quickly see what comes with your normal booking support and what sits under a separate planning fee.
settings.logged_out_title: Already a client? Log in to your private hub
settings.logged_out_message: Returning clients can log in here to access their itinerary, forms, ticket information, and payment touchpoints.
settings.guest_member_note: This keeps the public-facing pricing conversation and the private client experience connected inside one hub.
